consultations.purpose: Investigate first-century and documentary usage of the metanoeo, metanoia, and metamelomai families before completing the LPF lexical dossier.
consultations.method: Full normalized scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary testamentary usage of the diatheke family and seek exact parallels to the death-and-validity wording of Hebrews 9:16-17.
consultations.method: Literal discovery identified 12 pinned DDbDP XML candidates; their canonical EpiDoc branches and paired HGV records were scanned by normalized prefix. Literal exact-phrase discovery found no ἐπὶ νεκροῖς or θανατον candidate. This is a controlled candidate set, not a full-corpus concordance.
consultations.resultSummary: 45 diathek- surfaces: 17 near-contemporary (130-198 CE or broadly second century) and 28 later. The 130 CE will of Thatres explicitly permits revocation, states the condition of dying with that will, names heirs after death, calls the will valid, and records witnesses and seals. No exact first-century occurrence and no exact Hebrews 9:16-17 phrase was recovered.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary usage of Greek turning families before deciding whether Spanish convertirse/conversión preserves or obscures their distinctions.
consultations.method: Full normalized scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata; supplied and unclear letters retained.
consultations.resultSummary: 131 target-prefix surfaces. Three occurrences dated 98-117 CE touch the first century and concern attention/consideration or debtors attending to repayment, not religious affiliation. Near-contemporary contexts also include physically turning a stone, returning, redirecting, and giving or withholding attention.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary usage of psyche before deciding when Spanish alma, vida, persona, or another contextual realization is accurate.
queryScope: normalized exact singular forms of ψυχή
normalized exact plural forms of ψυχή
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata; unrelated psych- derivatives excluded.
consultations.resultSummary: 284 surfaces. Fourteen are dated near, within, or across the first century/early second century. Early contexts include inner disposition, emotional state, intention, wholehearted action, affection, moral condition, and the remembered identity of a deceased person; no single Spanish gloss covers them all.

queryScope: 45 normalized exact inflectional forms attested in Scrivener/Robinson
manual separation of verbs, abstract nouns, adjectives, personal names, calendar names, and royal or divine titles
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata. A preliminary prefix scan was rejected because it captured unrelated personal names; exact-form homographs remain visible and require contextual review.
consultations.resultSummary: 1,154 exact-form surfaces: 121 dated within the first century CE, 27 overlapping it, and 283 in 100 BCE-200 CE. Documentary contexts use the family for personal safety or welfare, preservation of records and property, royal or divine Savior titles, and oaths for another person's welfare; exact homographs also include personal and calendar names.

proskyneo, latreuo, sebomai, eusebeo, threskeia, and ethelothreskeia families
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata; homographs and multilingual contexts remain visible for review.
consultations.resultSummary: 196 exact-form surfaces: 28 dated in 100 BCE-200 CE and 4 whose dates overlap that period. Proskyneo appears in respectful approaches to relatives, superiors, honored persons, emperors, clergy, and deities; threskeia denotes religious observances and sacrifices. The family is not a technical synonym for worship of God alone.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary usage of ekklesia and distinct assembly or council families before deciding Spanish iglesia, asamblea, congregación, sinagoga, and consejo.
queryScope: 17 normalized exact Scrivener/Robinson forms of ekklesia, synagoge, synedrion, and panegyris
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions, with canonical EpiDoc branch selection and paired HGV metadata; formal families remain separate and late Christian evidence is not projected backward.
consultations.resultSummary: 971 surfaces. The 899 ekklesia surfaces are overwhelmingly late Christian references to churches, clergy, buildings, or property; the earliest securely dated hit is about 200 CE. Near-contemporary synagoge examples often mean gathering crops or materials, while synedrion denotes a council or hearing. Documentary evidence must therefore be read diachronically.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary usage of baptism, dipping, bathing, and purification families before deciding Spanish bautizar, bautismo, sumergir, lavar, and purificar.
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions with paired HGV metadata; late Christian titles and ordinary bath terminology remain visible and are not projected backward.
consultations.resultSummary: 82 surfaces. Only one is near-contemporary and means cleaning stones. Most results are late bath-house references, Christian baptism terminology, or John the Baptist titles; the documentary corpus supplies little early ritual evidence.

consultations.purpose: Test documentary usage of apostolos before deciding Spanish apóstol, enviado, emisario, delegado, and mensajero.
queryScope: 7 normalized exact inflectional forms attested in Scrivener/Robinson
consultations.method: Full normalized exact-form scan of 67,981 DDbDP XML transcriptions with paired HGV metadata; administrative, shipping, Christian, place-name, and other diachronic uses remain visible.
consultations.resultSummary: 152 surfaces, including 13 securely dated in 100 BCE-200 CE. The near-contemporary evidence uses apostolos especially for an administrative or shipping dispatch, authorization, order, account, or mission, not exclusively for a religious office.
